# GreenGridStability

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A rethinking of power grid design that prioritizes dynamic stability over mere renewable energy integration, considering network topology and control dynamics. Offers a real-world application where TCC principles (topology-aware control) and iNEST (neuromorphic stability prediction) can jointly address critical infrastructure resilience.
